The destination dispatch proof records checks for bound grants. Authentication and dispatch reject unapproved destinations and revoked grants. HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 queued requests stop while admitted streams complete. The affected run passes 447 events with one Valkey skip. Final repeated checks pass 63 events.

The credential identity proof binds grants to source-owned material handles. Account and shared selections remain distinct. Rotation preserves the logical handle and changes its material version. The affected run passes 546 events with three Valkey skips. Nine repeated identity checks pass.

The approval selection proof connects supplied approval sets to router credential selection. Missing and revoked approvals stop connector invocation. The declared strategy can select another approved credential role. Final checks pass 561 events with one Valkey skip. Nine repeated routing checks pass.

The path-template proof covers model namespaces and job paths. Template matches retain exact request targets through dispatch. Final checks pass 584 race events with one Valkey skip. Authorization and rechecking use zero measured allocations.

The contract compiler proof covers 13 embedded profiles, fixed tenant parameters, local overrides, and job targets. Final checks pass 622 race events with one Valkey skip. The compiler requires an approved provider record.

Application composition does not supply approvals yet. Next, bind pinned contracts and selected explicit configuration to credential handles. Supply approvals at startup and connection tests. Then remove unbound authentication.
